### `Algorithm`

```csharp
EncryptionAlgorithm Algorithm { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the encryption algorithm to use. Default is RC4_128 (128-bit RC4).

### `EncryptMetadata`

```csharp
bool EncryptMetadata { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets whether AES-256 encrypts the XMP metadata stream. When false, XMP remains readable without a password; other PDF strings stay encrypted. Legacy RC4 always encrypts metadata. Default is true.

### `OwnerPassword`

```csharp
string OwnerPassword { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the owner password (permissions password). Required for encryption. Controls access to change permissions and passwords.

### `Permissions`

```csharp
PdfPermissions Permissions { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the document permissions. Default is All (no restrictions).

### `RevisionValue`

```csharp
int RevisionValue { get; }
```

*read-only*

Gets the /R (revision) value for the encryption dictionary.

### `UserPassword`

```csharp
string UserPassword { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the user password (open password). If set, users must enter this password to open the document. Can be null or empty for no open password.

### `VersionValue`

```csharp
int VersionValue { get; }
```

*read-only*

Gets the /V value for the encryption dictionary.
